complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate has clear hero forms—the black silhouette, cropped boot, and blue vinyl bar—but many small photo chips and puncture clusters create a busy field. It remains legible as expressionist collage, though close to clutter at the lower edge.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
